label: TIMING SCANDAL
voice_script: What if sports records became... optional? The Enhanced Games burst onto the scene, pledging to shatter human limits and rewrite the rulebook. But their very first 50-meter freestyle event immediately ignited an unparalleled controversy. The official clock flashed an impossible 20.81 seconds – a time not just faster, but *unthinkable* for any human in history. Yet, the footage doesn't lie: the swimmer hadn't even grazed the wall! Independent hand-timers quickly revealed the true finish was between 21.0 and 21.1 seconds, exposing a staggering discrepancy. Consider this: the actual, legitimate 50-meter world record, held by the legendary Cesar Cielo, is 20.91 seconds. This wasn't just a timing error; it cast an immediate, dark shadow over the entire Games. Were these 'Enhanced' Games setting new records... or just new precedents for scandal?

screens.subtitle: Before. He. Even. Touched. The. Wall.
An impossible time. The evidence is clear.
21.0 to 21.1 seconds. A world of difference.
Or just an enhanced controversy? YOU DECIDE.
